meta_description: Independent cybersecurity awareness by Jatoth Ramakrishna. Check scam warning signs privately, make an action plan, and find official reporting channels.
independent_notice: Official project website · Independently owned by Jatoth Ramakrishna
language_notice: Changing language clears unsaved tool input.
hero_description: Practical digital safety tools for the moments that matter. Spot warning signs, work out your next steps, and find the right official reporting route.
hero_private: Citizen tools run on your device
hero_no_account: No account or sensitive details needed
overview_description: Stop. Check the source. Take one safe next step.
overview_footer: Public awareness tools · Official reporting links
quick_01_body: Understand what a suspicious message is asking you to do.
quick_02_body: Protect your money and accounts before you investigate.
quick_03_body: Work through fictional alerts and short safety checks.
checker_title: Find warning signs before you act.
checker_intro: Paste a message or link. Analysis happens entirely in this browser; your text is not sent to our server. A score is a prompt to verify, never proof of fraud or safety.
checker_placeholder: Paste the suspicious message or link here…
checker_limit: Maximum 2,000 characters. Never paste passwords, OTPs, UPI PINs, full account numbers or private victim details.
checker_empty_body: Read the domain findings, warning signs and limitations. Local checks do not establish the safety of every page or message.
checker_local_note: No uploads. No saved messages. No account required.
fraud_guide_one_body: A fine, delivery fee or KYC deadline pushes you to a link. Open the official app or type the known official address yourself.
fraud_guide_two_body: A job, prize or cashback asks for an advance fee. Receiving money does not require your UPI PIN.
fraud_guide_three_title: A request for access or secrets
fraud_guide_three_body: A caller asks for an OTP, screen sharing or a remote-access app. End contact and verify through the provider's published support channel.
planner_title: Start with the next safe step.
planner_intro: Choose what happened. The plan stays on this device. You do not need to describe the incident or share identifying details.
planner_money: I sent money or see an unauthorised payment
planner_credentials: I shared a password, OTP or account access
planner_message: I received a suspicious message or link
planner_account: I suspect someone has taken over my account
planner_malware: I suspect malware or ransomware on my device
planner_download_note: A download saves this checklist to your device only when you choose it.
planner_access: Does the other person still have access to your device?
planner_empty: Your ordered response plan will appear here.
planner_note: This tool cannot file a complaint, block a transaction or contact your bank. Use the official channels in your plan.
help_title: Money lost to cyber fraud? Act promptly.
help_body: Contact your bank or payment provider through its official channel. Call 1930 for financial cyber fraud in India and use the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal to submit your complaint. Recovery is not guaranteed.
help_international: Outside India? Use your local police or national reporting channel. The directory below explains each agency's remit.
help_emergency: For immediate danger in India, call 112. This independent website is not an emergency service or a police reporting portal.
training_intro: A short, practical knowledge check. Your answers stay in page memory and are not submitted or saved by this site.
quiz_note: Learning exercise · No tracking or certification
no_results: No matching entries. Try a broader search.
resources_intro: Twenty official cyber portals in one reference directory. Agencies have different roles: incident response, public guidance, policy or law-enforcement coordination. A listing does not imply affiliation or a shared reporting service.
external_link_notice: External links open in a new tab. Visit the agency's site to confirm its current remit and reporting process.
assistant_intro: Choose a topic for a short, structured guide. This is a local reference assistant with reviewed rules, not a live chat or a reporting service.
assistant_topic: What do you need help with?
assistant_payment: Someone is asking for a payment
assistant_otp: Someone is asking for an OTP or PIN
assistant_device: Someone asked me to install an app
assistant_report: I need to report cyber fraud
assistant_empty: Choose a topic to read the guidance.
privacy_local_body: The checker and action planner run in browser memory. They do not upload or persist your inputs. This site uses no analytics, advertising pixels, chat services or browser storage for these tools.
privacy_limits_title: A warning score is not a verdict
privacy_limits_body: Local checks can miss new attacks and flag legitimate content. A known domain, HTTPS or a low warning score cannot guarantee that a page or message is safe. Verify independently through the organization’s known official channel.
privacy_network_body: Your browser requests this website's pages and static assets. These requests never include tool input. Hosting infrastructure may retain connection and security metadata such as an IP address. This site does not poll advisory services or send text to a cloud assistant. Do not put personal incident details into URLs. External sites have their own privacy policies.
privacy_independent_body: CYBER SURAKSHA 2.0 is independently architected, developed, authored and owned by Jatoth Ramakrishna for public cybersecurity awareness and operational defense. It has no institutional partner, sponsor or external funding.
footer_mission: Practical cybersecurity awareness, built independently for the public.
footer_ownership: Independently architected, developed, authored and owned by Jatoth Ramakrishna.
footer_no_affiliation: No institutional affiliation, sponsorship or external funding. Official agency links are references only.
javascript_notice: JavaScript is required for on-device analysis and interactive exercises. The emergency links and official directory remain available without it.
portal_intro: Raise a support complaint, follow its progress and receive status updates. This service is managed independently by Jatoth Ramakrishna.
portal_boundary: This is not a government or police complaint portal. For financial cyber fraud, contact your bank promptly and use cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930 in India.
portal_private: Your account and submitted complaint are stored on the service and can be reviewed by the authorized administrator. The private checker and planner continue to run on your device.
portal_register_body: Use your email address and a new password for this website. We will verify your email with a one-time code.
portal_login_body: Enter your CYBER SURAKSHA account password, then confirm the code delivered to your email.
portal_admin_body: Owner access is restricted to the configured administrator account. Email verification and an authenticator code protect administrative changes.
privacy_account_body: When you register or submit a complaint, your name, email and submitted information are stored to operate your account and provide updates. The owner can review complaints and login security records. Do not submit passwords, OTPs, PINs or identity-document numbers.
name: Full name
password_hint: Use at least 12 characters. Choose a password for this website, not your Gmail or email-account password.
email_hint: Verification codes and complaint-status notices are sent to this address.
register_consent: I understand this is independent support, not a police report. I agree that my account and submitted complaint information will be stored and reviewed by the authorized owner.
verify_intro: Enter the six-digit code sent to your email address. Codes expire after five minutes and have a limited number of attempts.
otp_privacy: Do not share this code. We never ask you to send it to a caller or paste it into the scam checker.
forgot_intro: Enter your account email. If a matching account is available, we will send a password-reset code.
reset_intro: Use the code sent to your email and a new CYBER SURAKSHA password. Your email-account password is never needed.
form_required: All fields are required unless marked optional.
mfa_intro: Administrative changes require a recent code from the authenticator configured for this owner account.
mfa_setup_intro: Add the setup secret to your authenticator, then enter a current six-digit code. Keep your authenticator and recovery arrangements protected.
mfa_secret_note: This setup information is private. It is shown only during enrollment; never put it in a complaint or public document.
cases_intro: Follow the current status, read replies and add useful information. Each complaint is visible only to its account holder and authorized administrator.
cases_empty_body: Use the form to request independent assistance. For urgent fraud, use your bank and official reporting channels first.
new_case_intro: Give a short factual description and the steps you have already taken. This submission creates an independent support record, not an official police complaint.
subject_hint: A brief description without passwords or private account numbers.
case_details_hint: Do not include passwords, OTPs, PINs, full bank/card numbers or identity-document numbers. There is no document upload.
case_consent: I understand this is an independent support request. I agree that the information I submit will be stored and reviewed by the authorized administrator so they can respond.
case_reply_hint: Share only information needed to understand this complaint. No passwords, OTPs or full financial identifiers.
case_no_activity: No replies have been added yet.
case_notification_note: Status changes are recorded here and queued for email delivery. Email delivery may depend on the receiving mailbox and configured provider.
admin_intro: Review citizen support, account access and the public website’s structured content. Actions are checked and recorded.
admin_case_save: Save status and notify account holder
admin_case_update_note: The update and its notification record are saved together. Do not promise bank recovery, a police investigation or an outcome this service cannot provide.
admin_users_intro: Review names, email addresses and account state. Passwords, email codes and private signing keys are never displayed.
user_own_protected: The owner account cannot be disabled here.
login_activity_intro: These records help the owner investigate account-access problems. They contain no passwords or one-time codes.
admin_content_intro: Edit the approved structured content and all required translations. Changes are treated as text and validated links; this screen does not execute HTML, code or server commands.
content_help: Keep the existing structure, include English, Hindi and Telugu, and use HTTPS for external links. Refresh before retrying a conflicting edit.
content_empty: No editable content sections are available.
independent_support: Independent support · Not a government reporting channel

legal_scope: These policies cover the independent CYBER SURAKSHA 2.0 website, citizen accounts and support-case service operated by Jatoth Ramakrishna.
policy_local_title: Tools that stay on your device
policy_local_body: The scam checker, action planner, quiz and local safety assistant process their input in browser memory. They do not send pasted text to the account API, resolve pasted links or save your input in browser storage. Ordinary page and asset requests still reach the hosting provider.
policy_account_body: When you choose to create an account or submit a case, the service stores your name, email, authentication records and the information you submit in its hosted database. The authorized owner can review support cases and login security history. Do not submit passwords, OTPs, PINs, full bank details or identity documents. There is no attachment upload.
policy_google_body: Google is contacted only after you choose the Google sign-in option and acknowledge these policies. Google provides a signed identity assertion containing a stable account identifier, verified email and basic profile name. The backend verifies it and issues its own citizen session. It does not receive your Google password, request access to Gmail messages or grant administrator rights. Google has its own privacy policy.
policy_providers_body: GitHub Pages serves this website; Neon hosts the account API and database. Google processes optional sign-in. A configured email provider processes verification and status messages when those features are enabled. Providers can process connection and security metadata under their own policies. No advertising pixels or analytics trackers are installed.
policy_retention_body: Application session tokens and temporary Google sign-in challenges stay in this page’s memory. Reloading, closing the page or switching language signs you out of this website; it does not delete your stored account or case. Account and case records are retained for support and security review until the owner processes an appropriate deletion request. Automatic account deletion and a fixed deletion schedule are not currently offered.
policy_requests_body: Contact the owner through an authenticated support case for account or privacy questions. If you cannot sign in, request a private contact channel through the project repository without posting personal details or complaint evidence. The owner must verify account ownership before changing or deleting private records. This policy does not promise a statutory response period or automated deletion.
terms_independent_title: Independent support, not a police report
terms_independent_body: CYBER SURAKSHA 2.0 is independently architected, developed, authored and owned by Jatoth Ramakrishna. It has no institutional sponsor or government endorsement. A support case here is not a police complaint and does not guarantee investigation, protection or recovery. For financial cyber fraud in India, contact your bank promptly, call 1930 and use cybercrime.gov.in.
terms_appropriate_body: Submit only information needed to explain your own support request, and use fictional data when testing. Do not upload or paste passwords, one-time codes, payment PINs, full financial identifiers, identity documents, malicious files or other people’s unnecessary personal information. You acknowledge that the authorized owner can review submitted information to respond.
terms_access_body: Keep your sign-in credentials and authenticator codes private. Google sign-in creates or authenticates citizen access only; it does not link an existing password account merely because email addresses match. Do not attempt to access another person’s cases, impersonate an administrator, evade security controls or disrupt the service.
terms_limits_body: Educational tools and warning scores can miss attacks or flag legitimate content. Independently verify sensitive actions through trusted official channels. Service availability and message delivery can be interrupted. Stored case history is the primary place to check a support update; an email is not proof that a case has been resolved.
google_recovery_hint: Accounts created with Google must use Google Sign-In. Recover your Google account through Google; this website cannot reset your Google password.
test_workspace_body: Use fictional cases only. Do not submit real personal information or victim details.
unified_owner_description: Review fictional cases, registered accounts, authentication events and audit history with verified Google identity, a separate administrator password and authenticator MFA.
unified_owner_separation: Citizen and administrator sessions stay separate. This link never grants owner privileges.
unified_staging_notice: Staging preview · Fictional records only. Do not enter real personal or victim information.
